name: Andrii K.
text: Best skin fade I have had in Lviv. Quiet shop, no rush, and the hot towel at the end is a nice touch.

name: Marko S.
text: Booked online in a minute, walked in on time and was out looking sharp. Viktor knows exactly what he is doing.

name: Ihor P.
text: I took my son for his first proper haircut. Patient barber, great atmosphere, we will be back.
